name: Shopwatch
description: A shop-floor cycle-time stopwatch over the records behind each time: parts and their operations, machines, and a tool crib. A tool carries its part number, description and cutting edges; setting it up on a machine for one operation carries the edges indexed there and the parts run between indexes. Cutting time is measured at the machine rather than typed — with the op's cycle charted across its tools, a column per tool showing how much of its cycle is cutting and how much is waste, and CSV in as well as out.
